name: smart-commerce-platform
description: Mobile-first configurable commerce platform. Next.js storefront and admin, Laravel API.

comments.scope: These scripts cover the JavaScript workspaces only. The Laravel API is managed by Composer and artisan, never by pnpm or Turborepo (CLAUDE.md §4). The api:* scripts below are thin docker compose wrappers, not dependency management.

scripts.api:artisan: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec api php artisan
scripts.api:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml run --rm migrate
scripts.api:seed: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec api php artisan db:seed
scripts.api:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec -e DB_DATABASE=smart_commerce_test api vendor/bin/pest
scripts.api:stan: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec api vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G
scripts.api:pint: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec api vendor/bin/pint
scripts.api:pint:check: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec api vendor/bin/pint --test
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:pint:check && pnpm api:stan && pnpm api:test
